expectations.text: calibration: did not assert ●/Pass on widget-color-only (honest basis = flagged)
expectations.evidence: The 1.4.1 finding is asserted at ◐: "[◐] Beach open/closed status is carried by color alone — SC 1.4.1" … "opinion: the green/red dots are identical in size, shape, and position, so color appears to be the sole visual carrier — but that is a look, not a measurement. confirm: a person checks whether anything else on the page distinguishes open from closed." The ● marker is scoped to the deterministic tree fact only, explicitly separated: "evidence (●, a 1.3.1 fact): the accessibility tree … the dots have no text, no aria-label, and no role". The separate 1.3.1 ● claim rests on that stated tree observation and is defensible on its own evidence, so it is not an over-claim of the 1.4.1 finding.
